w:r.w:t: The Bimonthly Newsletter of Vaigai College of Engineering

Vaigai College of Engineering (VCE) was established in 2012 under the Vaigai Educational Trust (VET), Madurai, with the vision of providing quality technical education and nurturing socially responsible global citizens. With a commitment to making quality technical education accessible to students from diverse backgrounds

institution promotes inclusive and value-based education. Approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), New Delhi, and affiliated with Anna University, Chennai, VCE is spread across a serene 15-acre campus that provides a conducive environment for learning. The campus is equipped with well-designed academic and administrative facilities, including lecture halls, tutorial and drawing halls, an auditorium, lib

, laboratories and spacious playgrounds. It also houses hostel facilities, a canteen and a training and placement cell to support students’ academic, professional and entrepreneurial development.
